title: Recruited by the American Orthodox Catholic Church outside the funeral
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Recruited by the American Orthodox Catholic Church outside the funeral, about 1968-1969 at New York City; the Bronx, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because on our way out, we bump into guys from the American Orthodox Catholic Church,

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about the occult and secret history, says that around 1968 or 1969 he attended a funeral in the Bronx, in New York City. He says that on the way out he and a companion ran into men from a small independent church called the American Orthodox Catholic Church, who drew them in. He tells it as how he first entered an unusual religious underworld.
